CustomField.description: Optional. The module's admin tool and settings tabs, by API name unprefixed and separated by semicolons (a page tab whose label is not its name with spaces is written Name:Label), that belong in the BarnCRM Admin Console app, and in the module's app when App Name names an app another package ships. The source deploy adds them; the Setup Assistant lists them after a package install.
